title: Electromagnetic Duality Sensitivity of Holographic Complexity
summary: We investigate electromagnetic duality as a diagnostic of the sensitivity of information content of holographic complexity via "complexity=anything" in Einstein-ModMax theory. Functionals constructed solely from gravitational invariants are duality invariant, whereas matter-sensitive functionals can distinguish electromagnetic configurations that share the same bulk geometry and energy-momentum tensor.
